item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-0ee4a88ad75ca81f","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnistía Internacional stated that its 2023 assessment of Mexico identified concerns regarding violence against women and girls, militarization of public security and law enforcement, the right to social protest, freedom of opinion and expression, and journalist safety.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.3","3B.6","3B.7","3B.8","3B.10","4B.3","4B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The document was published 11 July 2023 and addresses Mexico's human-rights situation and implementation record relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source evaluates Mexico during López Obrador's presidency but does not attribute every concern personally to López Obrador.","limitations":["The supplied unit is an executive summary and does not provide underlying incidents, outcome measurements, or detailed attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f6a9a3d6e408bfcc","start_unit":3,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"On 4 December 2023, the UN General Assembly adopted a resolution on prohibiting the use of nuclear weapons by 120 votes to 50, with 14 abstentions; Mexico voted yes.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The vote occurred during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Mexico's state vote is attributable to the government during López Obrador's presidency, but the supplied record does not identify his personal direction.","limitations":["The record shows a vote on a General Assembly resolution, not ratification, implementation, funding, or operational nuclear-policy changes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8da9cc2e8634584b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 27 March 2023, the Supreme Court provisionally suspended the electoral Plan B to avoid impairing INE institutional operations and electoral-political and human rights; INE reported that the pre-2 March rules would remain in force, providing legal certainty.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.8","4B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The event and publication occurred in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source records judicial and electoral-institutional action concerning a reform associated with the federal government; it does not establish López Obrador's personal conduct beyond the policy context.","limitations":["The supplied material does not state the full contents of Plan B, the government's response to the suspension, or the final judicial disposition."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9c413e159a89807b","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A Mexican civil-society investigation reported that relatives and friends of López Obrador's sons occupied federal government posts, including positions in the SEP, IMSS, Semarnat, and CFE, and stated that López Obrador had not presented legislation regulating potential conflicts of interest involving him and his family despite an anti-corruption commitment.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.3","7B.5","7B.6","7B.9","7B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The source is an end-November 2022 report carried in a corruption yearbook; it provides background relevant to the 2023 period but is not a 2023 event record.","ruler_attribution":"The source expressly discusses López Obrador and his family, but reports allegations and an absence of legislation rather than a final legal finding of corruption.","limitations":["The supplied unit does not provide appointment dates, legal outcomes, procurement adjudications, or López Obrador's response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dfbf00a6308b3f07","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"López Obrador's published program described goals of reducing corruption, violence, and injustice; uplifting poor and Indigenous communities; and providing jobs and welfare, while presenting the book as the foundation of his proposed political program.","question_ids":["1B.7","3B.6","3B.7","5B.1","6B.1","6B.3","8B.1"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The source describes a 2018 manifesto and therefore supplies a pre-2023 program baseline rather than evidence of 2023 implementation or outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The program is presented as López Obrador's own stated program.","limitations":["The supplied material does not establish implementation, executed resources, appointments, outcomes, or adaptation during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-93672181bafd67f7","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The ILO's Mexico productivity study, published 9 October 2023, identified productivity constraints and areas for closer government and social-partner review, with practical policy and regulatory recommendations intended to improve productivity and support dialogue among government, employers, workers, and other stakeholders.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The study was published in October 2023 and concerns Mexico, but it evaluates structural productivity conditions rather than a specific López Obrador decision.","ruler_attribution":"The source addresses policy needs for the Mexican government and social actors without attributing the identified constraints or recommendations personally to López Obrador.","limitations":["The supplied unit does not state which recommendations were adopted, funded, implemented, or evaluated by the government."]},{"source_id":"SRC-99a87b8b603d3e68","start_unit":1,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Mexico was listed as a co-sponsor of the 2023 UN draft resolution on the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons; the record identifies the draft as A/C.1/78/L.24, dated 9 October 2023, and records Mexico among the authors.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The draft resolution was dated 9 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Mexico's sponsorship reflects a government position during López Obrador's presidency, but the supplied record does not establish his personal role or domestic implementation.","limitations":["Co-sponsorship of a draft resolution does not prove treaty accession, ratification, compliance, funding, or operational safeguards."]},{"source_id":"SRC-01a9a38da1b09cdf","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"An external audit of the 2023 public account reported that Fonatur Tren Maya had more than 2.442 billion pesos in expenditures for rights-of-way awaiting substantiation and more than 5.684 billion pesos in advances for property acquisition without completed legal ownership documents; the project transfer between Fonatur and a Sedena-controlled state company also remained incomplete and required revised deadlines.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","7B.7","7B.9","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The article was published in May 2024 but reports the 2023 public account and year-end conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The facts concern a major federal project initiated and administered under López Obrador's government; the supplied article does not establish his personal knowledge or direction.","limitations":["The supplied text reports audit and transfer irregularities but not final recovery, disciplinary action, or the project's full 2023 output and benefits."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d9698bda7b8c062d","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The UN Mexico 2022 results report stated that Mexico experienced growth in nearly all sectors, increased foreign direct investment, employment and formal employment, wage improvements associated with the minimum-wage increase, and social-support programs that helped contain poverty and reduce income inequality; it also identified persistent low growth, high inequality, labor-market vulnerability, environmental destruction, and pandemic and international-conflict effects.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report was published 24 May 2023 and assesses 2022 results, providing near-period outcome context rather than a direct 2023 evaluation.","ruler_attribution":"The report recognizes results involving the Mexican state and social programs but does not isolate López Obrador's causal contribution from subnational, external, or pre-existing factors.","limitations":["The supplied units do not provide numerical indicators, program-level attribution, regional distribution, or evidence of 2023 continuation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6202210ebaa03749","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Mexico's National Human Rights Commission issued Recommendation 110VG/2023 concerning alleged serious violations involving arbitrary detention and forced disappearance by elements of the National Guard and Mexico City security authorities in Huitzilac, Morelos, alongside torture, violations of personal integrity and security, delayed justice, and violations of the right to truth attributed to public servants of the Mexico City prosecutor's office.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The recommendation is a 2023 CNDH document and concerns conduct during the López Obrador period.","ruler_attribution":"The recommendation identifies national and subnational public authorities and security forces; it does not by itself establish López Obrador's personal order, knowledge, or response.","limitations":["The supplied units summarize the recommendation's subject but do not provide its factual findings, recommended remedies, acceptance, compliance, or disciplinary outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e117cb29a420cd46","start_unit":1,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 22 March 2023, four industrial radiography devices containing Iridium-192 sources were stolen from a licensed facility in Salamanca; the devices were recovered on 28 March without radiological harm, and regulatory inspectors verified improved security measures on 29 March. The IAEA rated the event INES 1, recorded degradation of defence in depth, and reported no public, worker, or environmental overexposure.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.8","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The incident and regulatory response occurred in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report identifies Mexican regulatory and law-enforcement actions but does not attribute decisions personally to López Obrador.","limitations":["The supplied report concerns one radiological-security incident and does not establish broader national safeguards, funding, inspection frequency, or long-term correction."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-66f2a67a21bdc237"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied extracts are webpage summaries and metadata rather than complete underlying reports in several cases; conclusions are limited to the labeled units.","Several sources describe institutional or national conditions without isolating López Obrador's personal decisions, knowledge, or causal responsibility.","The evidence includes documents published outside 2023 that report 2022 or 2023 conditions; period fit is stated per fact."]}
